Only the intended files changed, no unrelated modifications.

## Summary

- **`backend/app/models.py`**: added `is_verified: bool = False` to `UserBase`, inherited by both `User` (table) and `UserPublic` (read schema).
- **`backend/app/api/routes/users.py`**: added `POST /{user_id}/verify`, superuser-gated via `dependencies=[Depends(get_current_active_superuser)]`, 404s if the user doesn't exist, otherwise sets `is_verified = True` and returns the updated user.
- **`backend/app/alembic/versions/5db762f32067_add_is_verified_to_user.py`**: new migration adding the `is_verified` boolean column (`NOT NULL`, server default `false`), chained after the current head `fe56fa70289e`.
- **`backend/tests/api/routes/test_users.py`**: added `test_verify_user_super_user`, `test_verify_user_not_found`, `test_verify_user_without_privileges`, following the existing patterns exactly (including `db.refresh()` before the DB assertion, matching `test_update_user`).

Verified: `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh` passes (mypy, ty, ruff check/format), and the full backend test suite (`uv run pytest tests/`) passes — 63 passed, including the 3 new tests, against a live Postgres instance.
